rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prior Torah’s long-standing role as guide and mercy refutes the claim that revelation is an ancient fabrication: a lie would not have yielded such guidance and mercy.
rows.anchor: Eğer o bir ifk, bir yalan olsa idi o feyz ü rahmet olur muydu?

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Arabic Qur’an confirms the Torah and proves and supports the truth at its foundation.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur’an warns anyone who commits injustice and gives glad tidings to those who act beautifully.
rows.anchor: zulmedenleri inzar etmek için her kim olursa olsun kendisinden herhangi bir suretle zulüm, haksızlık sâdır olanlara Allah’ın azâbını haber

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The steadfast believers unite monotheism, the summary of knowledge, with steadfastness, the culmination of action; unlike Fussilat’s angel-mediated glad tidings, this passage gives them directly.
rows.anchor: ilmin hulâsası olan tevhid ile amelin müntehâsı olan istikāmeti cem‘edenler. حٰمٓ فُصِّلَتْ’de bu âyetin nazîrine bak; orada melâike vâsıtasıyla tebşir yapılıyordu

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kindness to parents is especially enjoined among the foremost marks of beneficent people, whose defining signs are faith and steadfastness.
rows.anchor: İman ve istikāmet en birinci şiarları olan muhsinlerin şânı beyan olunurken anaya babaya ihsan bilhassa tavsiye edilmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Parent-kindness appears in several verses, each serving a distinct purpose; here it is presented as a major example of beneficence and steadfastness linked to recompense for deeds.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says these two verses were revealed about Abu Bakr al-Siddiq and contain foundations for many legal rulings.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse emphasizes the mother in three respects: within the collective term for parents, in carrying the child, and in birth and nursing; the father is named only once.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A hadith ranks the mother as most deserving of kindness three times before naming the father.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mother bears pregnancy and birth with hardship; combining the verse’s thirty months with two years of nursing in 2:233 and separation in two years in 31:14 yields six months of gestation.
rows.anchor: hamli ve fisâli de otuz aydır Bakara’da وَٱلْوَٰلِدَٰتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَٰدَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage indicates the minimum gestation as six months and the maximum nursing period as two years; these limits bear on important rules concerning women’s honor, lineage, and marital inviolability.
rows.anchor: hamlin ekall-i müddeti, radâ‘ın da ekser-i müddeti gösterilmiştir. Zira bunlara kadının namusu, neseb ve hürmet-i nikâh cihetleriyle pek çok ahkâm-ı mühimme teferru‘eder.

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Ali
rows.claim: When Umar ordered punishment for a woman who delivered after six months, Ali cited this verse to argue that six months is the minimum gestation and the punishment did not apply; Umar agreed.
rows.anchor: Hazret-i Ali radıyallâhu anh bu âyeti ihtar ederek “had lâzım gelmez, hamlin ekall-i müddeti altı aydır” diye itiraz etti

rows.speaker: Fahreddin Râzî
rows.claim: Razi cites reason and experience for a six-month minimum, describing fetal formation, movement after doubling, and separation after a further doubled interval.
rows.anchor: Akıl ve tecribe dahi bunun böyle olduğuna delâlet ederler. Ashâb-ı tecârib diyorlar ki: Cenînin tekevvünü için mukadder bir zaman vardır

rows.speaker: Gālinus
rows.claim: Galen reports seeing a woman give birth after 184 days, while Avicenna records having witnessed the same; the author presents this as medical support for a six-month minimum.
rows.anchor: Calinus demiştir ki: ‘Ben, haml zamanlarının miktarlarını çok merak ile araştırırdım, bir kadın gördüm ki yüz seksen dört günde doğurdu.’

rows.speaker: Aristoteles
rows.claim: Aristotle is reported to say animal gestation is fixed but human delivery varies; seven or eight months can occur, eighth-month infants rarely survive except in some lands, and ninth-month birth is usual.
rows.anchor: Hayvanların vilâdet ve haml

rows.speaker: Ebû Ali İbn Sina
rows.claim: Avicenna reports a reliable account of a woman delivering after more than four years of pregnancy, with teeth already grown, and the child surviving; the Qur’an gives no maximum gestation limit.

rows.speaker: Ehl-i tecârib
rows.claim: Experienced observers say the gestational timing formula is approximate rather than an exact limit, allowing some days of variation.
rows.anchor: Ehl-i tecârib şunu da ihtar ederler ki ber vech-i bâlâ

rows.speaker: Fahreddin Râzî
rows.claim: Razi divides fetal development into six empirical stages; in the last, organs become distinguishable over roughly 30–45 days, which he says accords with the Prophet’s report of formation in forty days.
rows.anchor: Nihâyet der ki altıncısında a‘zâlar birbirinden seçilir ve hissolunacak vechile tebeyyün eyler, bunun mecmû‘u kırk gündür

rows.speaker: Ehl-i tecârib
rows.claim: Experienced observers say that after forty days, a small distinguishable form appears when the miscarried tissue is separated and placed in cold water.
rows.anchor: Tecribe sâhibleri derler ki: Kırktan sonraki sıkıt selâsı yarılıp da soğuk suya konulduğu zaman etrafı mütemeyyiz küçük bir şey zuhur eder.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He summarizes the minimum pregnancy as six months and the maximum nursing term as two years.
rows.anchor: Hâsılı hamlin ekall-i müddeti altı ay olduğu gibi radâ‘müddetinin de ekseri iki senedir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Grammatically, thirty months is the predicate of the combined phrase referring to pregnancy and separation.

rows.speaker: İmâm-ı A‘zam Ebû Hanife
rows.claim: Abu Hanifa also considers a reading in which both gestation and nursing each last thirty months at their maximum.

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Âişe
rows.claim: Aisha’s hadith rules out a pregnancy lasting more than two years, removing the thirty-month possibility for gestation; the two-year nursing period is qualified by the wish to complete nursing, leaving uncertainty about its maximum for milk-kinship rules.
rows.anchor: Hazret-i Âişe’nin rivayet eylediği bir hadîs-i şerîf hamlin ekser-i müddeti iki seneden ziyade olamayacağını ispat etmiş olmakla

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because no evidence removes the possibility that nursing’s legal maximum is thirty months, the juristic rule preferring prohibition over permission establishes milk-kinship precautionarily for nursing within that period.
rows.anchor: muharrim, mübîhe tercih olunmak kā‘ide-i usûliyesi mûcebince otuz ay içinde emişenler hakkında ihtiyâten hürmet-i radâ‘sâbit olmak lâzım gelir.

rows.speaker: İmâmeyn
rows.claim: The two disciples do not share this uncertainty because Luqman states separation as occurring in two years without a limiting qualification; the fatwa follows their position.

rows.speaker: author

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is said that prophets were all commissioned after forty, though the prophethood of Jesus and John in childhood is also a subject of discussion.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At forty, with reason and strength fully gathered, the person fulfills the parental counsel and asks God for three things.
rows.anchor: Allah’tan üç murad istedi. Birincisi şöyle nimetlerine şükür niyâzı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first request is for God to inspire and animate the speaker to give thanks for divine blessings upon him and his parents.
rows.anchor: Birincisi şöyle nimetlerine şükür niyâzı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gratitude comes first because it is tied to the joy of blessing; that joy is the secret of success and enables great deeds pleasing to God.
rows.anchor: bir neş’e-i nimet ile alâkadar olduğundan

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessing upon the speaker and his parents includes the blessings of religion and existence.
rows.anchor: vâlideynime anama babama, yani ni‘met-i din ve ni‘met-i vücud.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The second request is to perform a righteous deed pleasing to God; the indefinite form may magnify the deed, indicate many deeds, or a kind of deed especially pleasing to God.
rows.anchor: tenvin tâzim için, yani büyük bir iş.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The third request asks God to make righteousness spread among the descendants and establish it in them.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repentance means turning to God from acts He disapproves or from things that distract from His remembrance; being among Muslims means sincere submission to divine unity.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The concluding repentance and submission clauses indicate that a supplication’s soundness depends on repentance and Islam.
rows.anchor: Bu iki cümle duanın sıhhati tevbe ve islâma mütevakkıf olduğuna işarettir.

rows.claim: Ibn Abbas says Abu Bakr’s prayer for his descendants was accepted: all his children believed, and his parents, son, and grandson met the Prophet.
rows.anchor: Zürriyeti hakkında da duasını kabul buyurdu, evlâdlarının hepsi iman ettiler, ona hem anasının babasının hem de evlâdlarının cemî‘sinin islâmı müyesser oldu.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas says no Companion attained Abu Bakr’s degree of distinction; the author adds that all the Companions were filled with beneficence and steadfastness.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people singled out are distinguished beneficent and grateful people among Paradise’s inhabitants, whose faith and steadfastness bring the promise of no fear or grief on Judgment Day.

rows.speaker: müfessirîn
rows.claim: One exegetical view takes ahsan to mean hasan, simply good deeds.

rows.speaker: müfessirîn
rows.claim: Another exegetical view takes ahsan as acts of obedience above the permissible, encompassing recommended and obligatory deeds, since permissible acts are good but bring neither reward nor punishment.
rows.anchor: tâattir ki mendub ve vâcibe şâmildir. Zira mubah çirkin değil, hasendir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He prefers the apparent sense that sins are overlooked, ordinary good deeds serve like expiation, and the inhabitants’ ranks in Paradise correspond to their best deeds.
rows.anchor: zâhir olan şudur ki bunların seyyiâtlarından geçilmiş olduğu gibi alelâde hasenâtları da onlara keffâret gibi olarak cennetteki mertebeleri en güzel amellerine göre olmasıdır.

rows.speaker: Mücâhid
rows.claim: Tabari transmits Abu Bakr’s counsel to Umar: God’s night and day duties are distinct, and no voluntary worship precedes fulfillment of an obligatory duty.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın gecede bir hakkı vardır, onu gündüzün kabul etmez ve gündüzün bir hakkı vardır, onu da gece kabul etmez. Bizim hiçbirimiz için farzı edâ etmedikçe nâfile yoktur.

rows.speaker: Mücâhid
rows.claim: Abu Bakr says heavy scales result from following truth in worldly life when it felt weighty, while light scales result from following falsehood when it felt light; each outcome is fitting for what filled the scale.
rows.anchor: Kıyamet günü mîzanları ağır gelenlerin mîzanlarının ağır gelmesi hep dünyada hakka ittibâ‘ları ve onun onlara ağır gelmesi sebebiyledir.

rows.speaker: Mücâhid
rows.claim: Abu Bakr explains that Paradise’s people are mentioned by their best deeds because God has passed over and concealed their bad deeds.

rows.speaker: Mücâhid
rows.claim: Abu Bakr explains that Hell’s people are mentioned by their worst deeds because God has rejected their best deeds.

rows.speaker: Mücâhid
rows.claim: Abu Bakr says God pairs threat with approval and approval with threat so believers remain hopeful and reverent, avoid self-endangerment, and do not presume upon God without right.
